The dish is a white bowl about 15 cm across, holding pineapple chunks, strawberries, and a few blueberries.

The pineapple is about 8 chunks, each roughly 2.5 cm, or about 12-15 g each, so about 110 g. The strawberries come to roughly 4 pieces, about 50 g. The blueberries are about 8, so about 15 g. That gives a total of about 175 g.

For energy, pineapple is about 0.5 kcal/g, so 110 g is about 55 kcal. Strawberries are about 0.32 kcal/g, so 50 g is about 16 kcal. Blueberries are about 0.57 kcal/g, so 15 g is about 9 kcal. That totals about 80 kcal. The bowl looks fairly full, so I'll round up a little to allow for heavier pieces.
